compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

Add classify-bug-at-closure.sh invocation guidance to each skill's SKILL.md at Fixed: closure sites.

## For each SKILL.md
Read the skill file. Find all Fixed: closure sites (where ticket transition ... closed --reason='Fixed:...' is documented). Before or at each such site, add a note:

'Before closing with Fixed:, invoke the bug classifier: classify-bug-at-closure.sh <ticket-id> "Fixed:"'

Or equivalent phrasing that makes classify-bug-at-closure.sh visible to the orchestrator reading the SKILL.md.

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/end-session/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md (convert-to-epic closure path)
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (auto-resume fast-close path)
- plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md (if it exists)

## Done when
bash tests/scripts/test-skill-classifier-integration.sh exits 0.
